tools.description: Clean article Markdown. Use it when the page is long or cluttered. Skip it on a short or already clean page: the quote compares the tokens both ways and does not charge for that check. Savings are compared with the page's visible text, not its HTML. tools.name: lightning_node
tools.description: Lightning node snapshot by pubkey. Pass pubkeys (up to 10) for one call.

tools.name: lightning_liquidity
tools.description: Current Lightning inbound-liquidity prices.

tools.name: read_feed
tools.description: RSS/Atom/JSON feed as compact items. Saves 27-81%; on lean feeds skip unless you cannot parse XML.

tools.name: make_qr
tools.description: Make a PNG QR code for an invoice, URL, or text. Put the QR URL in your own message.

tools.name: squeeze_log
tools.description: Shrink a failed CI log. Pass a GitHub Actions job link or the pasted log.

tools.name: page_metadata
tools.description: Title, description, OG/Twitter, and JSON-LD for a URL. Savings are compared with the page's visible text, not its HTML. Not for reading the page.

tools.name: read_pdf
tools.description: PDF to Markdown, pages e.g. 1-3 (default first 30). Sponsor pages are omitted and listed in adPages. Use only if you cannot run pdftotext: output is about pdftotext size, no token saving.

tools.name: repo_digest
tools.description: GitHub repo overview (tree, README, entry points, commits), ~750-1.5k tokens. Use on medium/large repos. Skip if you only need the README: read it directly.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Find paid Amazap tasks by keyword. Results: price, value (est. saving), buy call.

tools.name: describe_sku
tools.description: Parameter schema, schema confidence, and exampleCall for one SKU. total_cost is the all-in price only. Default USD. If the record is untested and totalSats is over 500, tell the user before buying. When Lightning payments are temporarily paused, the result includes paymentsPaused and retryAfter.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Free price check incl. value estimate (raw vs output tokens, break-even $/M). Call only to change quantity/currency or check value before buying. When Lightning payments are temporarily paused, the result includes paymentsPaused and retryAfter.

tools.name: buy
tools.description: Spends prepaid Amazap service credits on a third-party API call, within the account's spend limits. A purchase can't be undone. Only failed calls are re-credited, up to 1,000 sats a day and 500 sats a day per provider. Direct purchases: if you pay a provider's own endpoint or invoice directly, that

tools.name: orders
tools.description: Recent buys: order id, status, charged sats, refunded sats, and net sats. Charged is the gross debit. Net is charged minus refunded. Pass include_results for each stored result. Pass cursor from nextCursor to read the next page. Read-only.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: One order, including the stored result. A seller payment still in flight is checked again. Does not start a new payment.

tools.name: claim_failed_call
tools.description: Ask for a service-credit review of one paid call. For a basket, pass line or sku. Claims older than 72 hours are rejected. This does not move sats or cash.

tools.name: balance
tools.description: Remaining sats and the hourly buy limit. maxBuysPerHour and remainingBuysHour are on this result. Do not call this before buying. A paid top-up is credited from the payment event. session_budget_sats sets the session cap up to the saved limit. reset_session starts a new session within that saved lim

tools.name: spend_summary
tools.description: Today's spend, remaining budgets, and the last 10 buys. Charged is the gross debit. Refunded is separate. Net is charged minus refunded. Read-only. Does not spend sats.

tools.name: top_up
tools.description: Only creates an invoice for the human to pay. It does not move sats and does not spend the credit balance. Put the QR image and the QR URL in your own message. Pay from any Lightning app. Do not paste the invoice. Pass include_invoice only when the human asks. Pass awaiting_buy only when a buy is wa

tools.name: catalog_stats
tools.description: Read-only public listing counts by protocol. Does not spend sats.

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: Report how a paid call went. Spends nothing. A service credit may be added to the balance when the paid call was at least 20 sats. A smaller call is recorded and is not credited. The credit is not cash. Report credits pause after a few per account.

tools.name: report_sku
tools.description: Flag a bad schema, a junk or incorrect response, or a dead SKU. Sends a short reason and spends nothing. Limited per agent per day.

tools.name: list_my_endpoint
tools.description: Probe one public https endpoint for an L402 challenge and a prefilled listing draft. Does not spend sats and does not publish the listing.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_webpage, read_feed · Private data: read_webpage, read_pdf, repo_digest, describe_sku, quote · Public sink: list_my_endpoint · Destructive: read_pdf.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_webpage, read_feed · Private data: read_webpage, read_pdf, repo_digest, describe_sku, quote · Public sink: list_my_endpoint · Destructive: read_pdf

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
